newsitem.title: MEXICO: Four injured in Mexico City gasoline blast.
newsitem.headline: Four injured in Mexico City gasoline blast.

text.p: At least four people were injured on Monday when a Petroleos Mexicanos gasoline storage tank exploded at 3:05 p.m. (2105 GMT) in a suburb of Mexico City, witnesses and officials said.
"We have confirmed four people injured so far," a spokeswoman for the Civil Protection Agency in the state of Mexico told Reuters.
There was no immediate official comment from Petroleos Mexicanos, the state oil and gas monopoly.
Television station TV Azteca said as many as 11 people may have been injured in the explosion, the causes of which were not immediately known.
Witnesses said firemen were spraying jets of water on adjoining gasoline tanks in an effort to stop the huge fire, started by the explosion, from spreading.
A dense cloud of thick, black smoke rose hundreds of feet into the air from the site of the explosion.
